title: Minimax Slope Estimation and Support Recovery under Weak Gaussian Selection
summary: In sample selection models, identifying a regression slope does not determine how accurately it can be estimated or distinguished from zero. We establish sharp uniform limits for outcome slopes in a fixed-dimensional Gaussian/probit selection model with unknown scale and an unknown covariate density bounded above and away from zero on a cube. We prove a uniform inverse bound between slope differences and observed-law Hellinger distance, allowing every nuisance parameter to differ between the two models. A matching path lies entirely within positive-correlation nonignorable selection. On…
